questions.question:
Consider the given statement to be true and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement:**

Public smoking has increased in the current year.

**Conclusions:**

1. Government should ban public smoking.

2. Government should create awareness about ill effects of public smoking.
questions.solution:
**Given:- **

Statement: Public smoking has increased in the current year.

Conclusions:

**1. Government should ban public smoking→ **This is a course of action or recommendation, rather than a logical conclusion derived from the factual statement.

**2. Government should create awareness about the ill effects of public smoking**→ This is also a course of action or suggested step, not a logical deduction based on the premise provided.

In logical reasoning, a conclusion is a direct inference that must be true based on the statement. Recommendations for actions do not follow as logical conclusions from a statement of fact. Therefore, neither conclusion follows.

Hence, "**Neither 1 nor 2 follows**" is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a certain code, if ZIGZAGGING is written as AZGIZGNIGG, then how will BLIZZARDLY be written as in the same code?
questions.solution:
The word is divided into two parts and then each part is written backwards,

ZIGZAGGING = ZIGZA + GGING = AZGIZ + GNIGG = AZGIZGNIGG

Similarly,

BLIZZARDLY = BLIZZ + ARDLY = ZZILB + YLDRA = ZZILBYLDRA

Thus, BLIZZARDLY is coded as ZZILBLYLDRA.

questions.question: What would be the smaller of the two angles formed by the hour hand and the minute hand at 4 : 52 p.m.?
questions.solution:
The angle between the hour hand and the minute hand when the clock shows 4.52 pm can be calculated using the following formula:

Angle =| {11{} over 2}M – 30 H |

Where, M = minutes and H = hours

Here, M = 52, H = 4

Therefore, we get angle= | {11{} over 2}× 52 – 30 × 4 | = |286 – 120| = |166°| = 166°

Hence, 166° is the correct answer.

questions.question: The length of one side of a rhombus is 61 cm and its area is 1320 cm². Find the sum of the lengths of its diagonals.
questions.solution:
In rhombus,

d₁² + d₂² = 4a² [where d₁, d₂ are the two diagonals of the rhombus and a is the side]

⇒ d₁² + d₂² = 4 × 61 × 61

⇒ (d₁ + d₂)² - 2d₁d₂ = 4 × 61 × 61 [where 1/2 × d₁ × d₂ = Area of rhombus = 1320 cm²]

⇒ 2d₁d₂ = 5280 cm²

⇒ (d₁ + d₂)² = 4 × 61 × 61 + 5280 = 20164

∴ Sum of length of diagonals, (d₁ + d₂) = √20164 = 142 cm

questions.question: What is the range of frequencies of sound waves audible to human beings?
questions.solution:
__Concept__:

Frequency: The number of waves that pass a fixed point in unit time.

The unit of frequency is Hertz (Hz).

__
 
• Infrasonic sounds have the frequency of less than 20 Hz and these are generally produced by sources of a bigger size such as earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, etc.
 
• Sound waves with frequencies below the audible range are called infrasonic.
 
• Audible sounds have the frequency of 20-20000 Hz since these are sensitive to the human ears
 
• And if the frequency is greater or less then audible frequency, human ear won't be able to sense it
 
• Ultrasonic sounds have a frequency greater than 20000 Hz and certain creatures such as dog, cat, a bat can hear this kind of sound.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ab16f768d60d2f5bdcf285fa654cd584d0298e72aa0b5fca38de435ee37dc27.png] 

Explanation:__

From the above explanation we can see that,

 
• Human Audible range has a frequency in the range of **20 Hz to 20,000 Hz.**
 
• Above this range of frequency, sound waves called **Ultrasonic sound waves**, which are only heard by animals like bats, whales. (Above 20,000 Hz ).
 
• Below this range of frequency, sound waves called **Infrasound waves**. (0.1 Hz to 20 Hz) They are generally used to monitoring earthquakes.
 
• Sound waves are **longitudinal waves**

questions.question: A watch loses 5 minutes every hour and was set right at 6 a.m. on a Monday. When will it show the correct time again?
questions.solution:
For the watch to show correct time again, it should lose 12 hours.

It loses 5 minutes in 1 hour.

It loses 1 minute in 12 minutes.

It will lose 12 hours or 720 minutes in = (720 × 12) = 144 hours = 6 days

So, It will show correct time again on 6 a.m. on Sunday.

questions.question: A wooden block of mass m₁ kg accelerates at 10 ms⁻² when a force of 5 N acts on it. Another block of mass m₂ kg accelerates at 20 ms⁻² when the same force acts on it. If both the blocks are tied together and the same force acts on their combination, the acceleration will be about:
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Force: The interaction which after applying on a body changes or try to change the state of motion or state of rest is called force.
 
• Force is denoted by F and the SI unit is Newton (N).

Force (F) = Mass (m) × acceleration (a)

**Calculation:**__

Given that,

acceleration of mass m₁ = 10m/s²

Force on block m₁ = 5 N

acceleration of mass m₂ = 20m/s²

As Force = Mass × Acceleration

→ In 1st case according to F = m × a

5 = m₁ × 10

m₁ = ½

→ In 2nd case according to F = m × a

5 = m₂ × 20 [same force is acting in both cases, given in ques]

m₂ = ¼

→ now, as the two boxes are tied together the total mass will become

M = m₁ + m₂

= ½ + ¼ => ¾

→ According to F = M × a

5 = ¾ × a

a = (5 × 4)/ 3 => 20/3

a = 6.67 ms⁻²

Molecular weight of Na₂CO₃.10H₂O = 2(23) + (12) + 3(16) + 10(18) = 46 + 12 + 48 + 180 = 286

questions.question: The mean of the 5 smallest numbers from a group is 15 while the mean of all the 13 members of the group taken together is 17. What is the mean of the 8 largest numbers?
questions.solution:
The mean of the 5 smallest numbers from a group is 15,

⇒ Sum of 5 smallest numbers = 5 × 15 = 75

The mean of all the 13 members of the group is 17

⇒ Sum of all the numbers = 13 × 17 = 221

⇒ Sum of the 8 largest numbers = 221 - 75 = 146

∴ Mean of the 8 largest numbers = 146/8 = 18.25

questions.question:
A and B together can do a piece of work in 10 days. If A can do the work in 15 days, find in how many days that B alone can do the same work. Given below are the steps involved in solving the above problem. Arrange them in sequential order.

(A) One day’s work of B is 1/10 - 1/15

(B) One day’s work of A and B is 1/10 and one day’s work of A is 1/15

(C) B alone can do the work in 30 days

(D) One day’s work of B is 1/30
questions.solution:
A and B together can do a piece of work in 10 days. If A can do the work in 15 days,

Step 1 = A’s one day work is 1/15 and One day work of A and B is 1/10,

Step 2 = One day work of B = One day work of A and B - One day work of A = 1/10 - 1/15

Step 3 = B’s one day work = 1/30

Step 4 = B alone can do the whole work in 30 days,

∴ Order is BADC.

questions.question: Akash’s monthly income is Rs. 9600. His monthly expenditure is 60% of his income. What is his saving per month?
questions.solution:
Akash’s monthly income is Rs. 9600, and his monthly expenditure is 60% of his income,

⇒ Expenditure = 60/100 × 9600 = Rs. 5760

⇒ Saving = Income - Expenditure = Rs. 3840

∴ Saving per month is Rs. 3840

questions.question: Two pipes namely A and B can fill a tank in 25 minutes and half an hour respectively and a pipe C can empty 3 gallons per minute. All three pipes working together can fill the tank in 15 minutes. The capacity of the tank is:
questions.solution:
A and B can fill a tank in 25 minutes and 30 minutes respectively and all the three pipes working together can fill the tank in 15 minutes,

Let the total capacity of the tank be 150 units,

⇒ In 1 minute, A can fill 150/25 = 6 units

⇒ In 1 minute, B can fill 150/30 = 5 units

⇒ In 1 minute, (A + B + C) can fill 150/15 = 10 units

But C can empty in 1 minute = (A + B + C)'s 1 minute work - (A + B)'s 1 minute work = 11 - 10 = 1 unit

⇒ C can empty 1 unit in 1 minute = 3 gallons per minute

∴ Capacity of the tank = 3 × 150 = 450 gallons

questions.question: Which of the following quantities remains constant and does NOT change from place to place?
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

__
 
• Physical quantities are classified into Fundamental and Derived quantities.
 
• Fundamental quantities are basic quantities which does not depends on any other factor 
 
• Derived quantities are a combination of two or more Fundamental quantities.

**Explanation**__

From the above explanation, we can see that 

 
• **Mass **of a body is a measure of the matter contained in it so, this value does not change under any condition i.e., it is a **fundamental quantity**
 
• Rest three Force due to friction, weight, and gravity are not the same at every place they change according to the location and depends on other fundamental quantities hence they are termed as derived quantities

questions.question: A boy raises a box with a weight of 120 N from a height of 2 m. The work done by him is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__240 J__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

__
 
• When a **force is applied **to an object which causes **displacement along the direction of force then the work is said to be done by that force.**
 
• The work done by a force is defined as **"the product of the component of the applied force on the block in the direction of the displacement and the magnitude of this displacement"** is called **work done**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• i.e., W = vec F.dvec x = Fdxcos theta 

or in terms of magnitude, it can be given as

W = F times s

 
• Here both **force and displacement** will be along the same direction since force is **causing this displacement** thus Work done is a scalar quantity.

 
 
• Here,
 
• **Force applied on object** = F
 
• **Displacement of object** = dx
 
• **Distance traveled by an object** = s
 
• **The angle between Force and displacement** = θ
 
 
 
• **Calculation:**__
 
 
• Given that,
 
• Person raised the box of **weight 120 N** through the **height of 2 m**
 
• i.e.,** F = 120 N **
 
• **x** = 2 m
 
 
 
• Thus from the above explanation, we can see that
 
• **Work = Force × Distance** moved in the **direction of the force**
 
• Force of **120 N** is acting downwards, Therefore
 
 
• **Work Done** = 120 × 2 =** 240 J**

questions.question: In a class when a test is conducted mean of 25 students marks is 60. If mean of first 13 students marks is 70 and mean of last 13 students marks is 50, find the marks of the middle student when arranged in the ascending order.
questions.solution:
Mean of 25 students marks is 60,

⇒ Total marks scored by 25 students = 25 × 60 = 1500

Mean of first 13 students marks is 70,

⇒ Total marks scored by first 13 students = 13 × 70 = 910

Mean of last 13 students marks is 50,

⇒ Total marks scored by last 13 students = 13 × 50 = 650

∴ Marks scored by middle student = 910 + 650 - 1500 = 60
